_comment: power_protocol can be 'nec' (use power_address/power_command) or 'raw' (use power_signal, a list of raw mark/space microsecond pulses). Defaults below are the confirmed-working LG TV NEC power-toggle code (address=0x04, command=0x08, 33% carrier duty) for an LG OLED77C9PUB.
_color_comment: ui_color_rgb/bg_color_rgb are [r, g, b] (0-255 each). Default is a dim/soft red, easy on the eyes at night. For a soft blue instead, try [20, 60, 160].
